item.title: Escaping Linux Sandboxes via PipeWire (CVE-2026-5674)
item.description:
This post walks through a sandbox escape from a Flatpak application via PipeWire that got fixed in July 2026. The vulnerability was discovered using my automated research pipeline using Claude Code and Opus 4.6 back then early April 2026. It was an exciting find, because this my first bug submitted to Red Hat.

Claude Code was also excited finding this:

Once discovered, I repro’d it manually to make sure it’s legit and then submitted it to Red Hat.
